entities.summary: Chidobe Chilorio Richard Awuzie is an American professional football cornerback for the Baltimore Ravens of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Colorado Buffaloes and was selected by the Dallas Cowboys in the second round of the 2017 NFL draft. He also played for the Cincinnati Bengals and Tennessee Titans.
